nodes.text: An empty classroom. The festival noise is muffled through the walls, distant and meaningless.
Hanami is sitting at a desk, a blanket draped over her shoulders. She looks small. Fragile in a way you've never let yourself see before.
Laura sits beside her, holding Hanami's hand. Tears run silently down her cheeks, but she hasn't said a word.
Cassian is by the window, arms crossed, staring at nothing. His jaw is clenched so tight you can see the muscle working.
Tiffany is pacing. Three steps one way, three steps back. Her hands are trembling.

nodes.speaker: Tiffany
nodes.text: Okay. You need to rest. We can talk about this later. The festival isn't over, and we still have--

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: Tiffany. Stop.
The room goes quiet. Hanami's voice is soft, but it carries the weight of something she's held inside for too long.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: I need to tell you all something. I should have said it a long time ago.
She takes a slow breath. Her fingers tighten around Laura's hand.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: I have a chronic illness. It's been getting worse for a while now. The doctors... they're not sure how much longer I'll be able to keep up with everything.
The words land like stones dropped into still water. No one moves.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: I don't know how much longer I can keep playing. I wanted to get through the festival first. I wanted to give us that, at least.

nodes.speaker: Laura
nodes.text: Hanami...
Laura's voice breaks. She squeezes Hanami's hand tighter, tears flowing freely now.

nodes.speaker: Tiffany
nodes.text: No. No, we'll find a way. There are treatments, there are specialists. The club NEEDS you, Hanami. We can't just--

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: Tiffany, please. I've seen the specialists. This isn't something you can schedule your way out of.

nodes.speaker: Cassian
nodes.text: DAMN IT!
Cassian's fist slams into the desk. The sound cracks through the room like a gunshot. Laura flinches. Tiffany goes still.
For a moment, there's only the sound of Cassian breathing hard, his hand flat against the desk, trembling.

nodes.speaker: Cassian
nodes.text: Not again. I can't... I can't do this again.
His voice breaks on the last word. The anger drains out of him all at once, and what's left underneath is something raw and old and terrible.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: Cassian... I'm sorry. I know this brings back--

nodes.speaker: Cassian
nodes.text: Don't. Just... don't apologize for being sick.
He turns away, pressing his forehead against the window glass. His shoulders shake once, then go rigid.

nodes.speaker: Laura
nodes.text: We're here, Hanami. Whatever happens. We're not going anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Tiffany
nodes.text: There has to be something we can do. There has to be.
Tiffany's voice has lost its commanding edge. She sounds like a girl grasping for control in a world that won't give her any.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: You can be here. That's what you can do. That's enough.
She looks at you. Her eyes are calm, steady, as if she's had time to make peace with this in a way none of you have.

choices.text: We'll support you no matter what.
You should have told us sooner.

nodes.speaker: MC
nodes.text: We'll support you. No matter what. Whatever you need, whenever you need it -- we're here.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: Thank you. That means more than you know.

nodes.speaker: MC
nodes.text: Why didn't you tell us sooner? We could have helped. We could have... I don't know. Done something.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: Because I didn't want to be the reason everything fell apart. I wanted to be part of the music, not the thing that stopped it.

nodes.speaker: Tiffany
nodes.text: You wouldn't have been. We would have adjusted. We should have known.
The silence that follows is heavy, but it's shared. For the first time, there are no masks in this room.

nodes.speaker: Cassian
nodes.text: My sister... she was sick too. She didn't tell anyone until it was too late.
Everyone looks at Cassian. He's still facing the window, but his voice is steady now. Hollow, but steady.

nodes.speaker: Cassian
nodes.text: I'm not going to pretend this is okay. It's not. But at least you told us. At least we know.

nodes.speaker: Hanami
nodes.text: I'm sorry I waited so long.

nodes.speaker: Laura
nodes.text: Don't be sorry. Just... let us be there for you. Please.

nodes.speaker: Tiffany
nodes.text: We'll figure this out. We always do.
But Tiffany's hands are still shaking. And you can see it in her eyes -- she doesn't believe her own words.
Outside, the festival continues. Music drifts in from somewhere far away. It sounds like another world.
